Nivel de vechime: Asociat
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Who We Are
 Our client, is a global consumer goods company with a diverse portfolio of well-known brands and a strong focus on innovation, technology, and operational excellence.
We are looking for an experienced Copilot Studio Developer to design, develop, and implement AI-powered conversational solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio and Azure services. The role involves building intelligent agents, integrating enterprise systems, and delivering scalable AI solutions that support business processes and improve operational efficiency. The ideal candidate has strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities, takes ownership of their work, and demonstrates excellent attention to detail. A proactive mindset, adaptability, and the ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams and business stakeholders are essential.
 What You'll Be Doing
Design, develop, and maintain AI-powered conversational agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio.
Configure topics, conversation flows, triggers, entities, and actions to deliver effective user interactions.
Integrate Copilot Studio agents with Microsoft Power Platform components, including Power Automate and Dataverse.
Leverage Azure services to extend Copilot Studio capabilities and support custom integrations and functionalities.
Develop and manage integrations with enterprise applications, APIs, and external systems.
Implement authentication, security, and access control mechanisms for AI-powered solutions.
Optimize agent performance, response accuracy, and overall user experience.
Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
Troubleshoot, test, and continuously improve conversational agents and integrations.
Support deployment, monitoring, and maintenance of solutions across different environments.
 What You'll Bring Along
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Informatics, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
At least 5 years of experience in software development, ideally within the Microsoft ecosystem.
Hands-on experience developing solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio.
Experience with Microsoft Azure services and cloud-based application development.
Good knowledge of Microsoft Power Platform, particularly Power Automate and Dataverse.
Experience with REST APIs, custom connectors, and system integrations.
Knowledge of authentication and security concepts, including Microsoft Entra ID.
Familiarity with conversational AI, generative AI, and large language models (LLMs).
Experience with programming or scripting languages such as C#, JavaScript, or Python.
Understanding of application lifecycle management, deployment, and version control.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent command of both spoken and written English.
 Nice To Have
Microsoft certifications such as PL-400, PL-500, PL-600, or AI-900.
Experience with Azure Functions, Azure Logic Apps, Azure AI services, or Azure OpenAI.
Knowledge of Microsoft Bot Framework and Adaptive Cards.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and Azure DevOps.
Familiarity with Power Platform ALM and environment management.
Experience implementing enterprise-grade AI agents and integrating them with business applications.
